notes.content:
Our summer sale is almost over and trust us, you're not gonna want to miss this.

notes.title: Aspyr's 2024 Summer Sale
notes.content:
It's officially the hottest time of the year and you know what? 

We think that the classic summer beach vacation is overrated. 

That's why we're offering you dozens of alternate vacation locations, all available from the comfort (and AC) of your own home!

Why not boot up [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478970/Tomb_Raider_IIII_Remastered_Starring_Lara_Croft/]Tomb Raider I-III Remastered[/url] and visit Atlantis, Venice, or India? Or visit over a dozen planets from the Star Wars galaxy in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446550/STAR_WARS_Battlefront_Classic_Collection/]Star Wars Battlefront: Classic Collection[/url]?

You can visit all these travel destinations and more in the games in Aspyr's 2024 Summer Sale!

Don't forget to start your summer off right by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419090/STAR_WARS_Bounty_Hunter/]pre-ordering Star Wars: Bounty Hunter now![/url]
